Book demo Among our Clients Our Partners With Prestatech you can enhance your lending and monitoring proposition Approve 10-35% more customers without increasing risk exposure Cut portfolio losses by 15-40% with predictive risk insights Accelerate loan decisions by 5x with automated data processing Reduce manual review time by 80% through intelligent document automation Book demo FAQs What is Prestatech and who uses it? Prestatech is an intelligent lending-automation platform that blends machine-learning document processing with real-time cash-flow analytics to speed credit decisions for SME and consumer lenders. How does your Cash-Flow Scoring work? We analyse a borrower’s complete bank-account transaction history, transform thousands of signals into a 0-100 synthetic score, and surface risk factors impossible to see in traditional bureau data. What data sources can the platform read? Our APIs ingest open-banking feeds, uploaded financial statements, invoices, payslips and other documents, standardising them into one analytics model. What types of data do you analyze? Bank-account transactions plus alternative financial data (for both consumers and SMEs) feed our analytics and scoring models. How does Intelligent Document Automation reduce manual credit work? Our computer-vision system automatically captures and analyzes any document type, speeding credit assessment, onboarding, and back-office tasks. Are you compliant with data-security standards like GDPR and ISO 27001? Yes—our secure cloud infrastructure follows enterprise-grade standards, including ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance. What measurable outcomes can lenders expect? Clients see faster approvals and lower default rates by using real-time analytics and data-driven insights throughout the credit lifecycle. Who is Prestatech built for? For any type of Bank and Modern lenders focused on SME and consumer credit who want to automate risk intelligence and decisioning. How do real-time bank-account analytics improve credit decisions? Streaming transaction insights reveal cash-flow health and behavioral patterns instantly, enabling more accurate, timely lending decisions. Why do leading banks choose Prestatech for cash‑flow scoring? Major European banks use our cash‑flow analytics. A Tier‑1 bank case showed ECB‑approved cash‑flow models, >80% acceptance for statement parsing, ~70% time saved per dossier, and our reports helped resolve 32% of UTP cases. What ROI or efficiency gains can we expect with cash flow analytics? Customers see a 20% increase in approvals for borrowers without a traditional credit history, three-month early distress detection, an 80% reduction in manual tasks, and five-times faster loan response. At portfolio scale, they also achieve a 25 to 40% improvement in credit decision accuracy and an 80% reduction in manual portfolio review time. Is Prestatech recognized globally by independent rankings? Yes. Prestatech announced its inclusion in CNBC & Statista’s World’s Top FinTech Companies 2025 ranking as a leader in cash-flow analytics category. Why is cash‑flow analysis essential in modern underwriting? Supervisors now stress robust, prospective cash‑flow assessment in loan origination, and research shows transaction‑level data improves risk prediction and expands access for thin‑file borrowers. Cash‑flow underwriting adds predictive power beyond bureau data and supports stronger monitoring. How does Prestatech use AI in its solutions ? Unlike black-box scoring, our computer vision and analytics engines are deterministic, replicable, and fully traceable, producing explainable outputs at every step. Every output can be audited and defended, with full traceability for regulators and internal audit, which is critical for model risk governance in regulated lending and lets risk teams stand behind every decision. How quickly can Prestatechs software be implemented for my bank? Our architecture is API-first, so we slot into existing workflows and core systems without rip-and-replace. Pre-built widgets go live in days, full API integration typically takes one to two weeks, and enterprise data-lake deployments run eight to twelve weeks. How customizable are the Prestatech products for different lending institutions and loan products? All parameters are configured to each lender's policies, including pass/fail thresholds, referral rules, risk appetite, and tag taxonomy. We support everything from consumer, sub-prime SME to corporate, and our team advises on calibration based on portfolio mix and risk profile. Can Prestatech’s solutions improve client retention? Yes. Real-time financial health monitoring surfaces early signals such as cashflow deterioration, churn risk, and cross-sell opportunities, so bankers can intervene with the right offer at the right time. Automating manual document and underwriting work also frees relationship managers to spend more time with customers and anticipate needs rather than react to them. What types of loans can Prestatech’s solutions handle? Our solutions handle SMB and consumer lending across term loans, cash advances, credit cards, mortgages, equipment finance, and specialty credit. The analytics layer supports both origination (affordability and financial health scoring) and portfolio monitoring (early warning and repayment capacity). Which systems does Prestatech integrate with? Our platform is system-agnostic and API-first. We connect to core banking platforms, LOS, and proprietary systems, as well as major data lakes such as AWS, Azure, GCP, and Snowflake. Integration channels include REST APIs, pre-built widgets, SFTP for bulk ingestion, and dashboards for brokers and underwriters.
